name: Community robot arm - five bar linkage
_notes: nodes: 'fixed' nodes are pinned at x,y. 'free' nodes are solved.
'branch' on a free node picks which of the two circle-intersection
solutions to use (1 or -1) when the node is found from two neighbours.
vectors: role 'control' means its angle is an input you drive.
role 'dependent' means its position falls out of the solve.
'length' may be left out when both ends are fixed nodes - it is
'attachments' pins another node partway along the vector, at the
given distance from its start node. Everything on a vector is
collinear and rigid, so any two known points fix the rest.
min_angle / max_angle may be a number, or {relative_to, offset} to

explanations.control_step: The step size for each control input (degrees).
explanations.cell: The size of the grid cells used to check for collisions.
explanations.body_samples: The number of samples along each vector to check for collisions.
explanations.clearance: The minimum distance from any obstacle to consider a position valid.
